messages:
alex_devx: Heads-up — we need to lock the SKU taxonomy + trial sizing for the cloud listings (AWS / GCP / Azure). Target: EOD Wed. @rachel_partners @sam_legal can you confirm constraints?

rachel_partners: On it — can we standardize on 3 SKUs: Starter (small), Pro (mid), Enterprise (custom/quote)? Keeps the listing clean.

devon_ops: Quick note: GCP metering prefers vCPU or instance-hour dimensions, while AWS often uses SaaS metering or BYOL. Need to decide metric (user-seat vs vCPU) before packaging.

sam_legal: From legal side: trial T&Cs should be 14-day, no auto-charge, clear data-retention and support scope. I'll draft a short clause. Any EU-specific constraints? @maria_gdpr

maria_gdpr: EU requires a DPA + clear data-region option. Also need a checkbox for analytics opt-out in the trial flow. We'll need a field in the listing metadata for data_region.

alex_devx: Packaging question: do we provide an AMI (AWS) / image (GCP) in addition to container artifacts? Some channel partners ask for AMIs for offline installs.

rachel_partners: AMI + container image for all three clouds seems safest but increases artifact maintenance. Recommend AMI for AWS only if we can automate build. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: marketplace-bot: Reminder — seller account verification required before publishing. See https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management for steps.

devon_ops: Technical checklist I can own. Will confirm ports, required infra, and provide both CFN + terraform templates. Planning to include: 
```
- network config (ports 443, 22 optional)
- IAM roles + minimal permissions
- AMI build script (if AMI used)
- container deployment manifest
```

sam_legal: I'll need the final SKU prices to calculate marketplace commission impact and contract language. Can we agree on pricing ranges today?

rachel_partners: Proposed pricing: Starter $49/mo, Pro $499/mo, Enterprise: contact sales (annual + custom). Open to adjustments for EU / education accounts.

maria_gdpr: For EU public listings, show price ex-VAT and provide VAT handling notes. Also flag any telemetry that leaves EU.

alex_devx: Action items (summary):
- Rachel: finalize SKU names + pricing + marketing blurb
- Sam: draft trial T&Cs + contract snippet for marketplace
- Devon: CFN + terraform + AMI build plan (if we do AMIs)
- Maria: confirm DPA language + data_region field and EU pricing notes
Let's sync tomorrow 9am PT to lock.

devon_ops: 9am PT works for me — I'll post initial CFN snippet in #eng-docs and attach a minimal test template.

rachel_partners: Sending pricing sheet to the shared drive now: https://drive.internal/redwood/marketplace-pricing (link posted)

sam_legal: Got it, will add contract PR and ping when draft is ready.

marketplace-bot: seller-account-status: verified=false — next step: submit tax docs + bank info (see console).

alex_devx: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical checklist. If anything changes post-sync, update the checklist and ping folks. :eyes:
